svg.text: Fall seven times, stand up eight.
Once in a lifetime, treasure this moment.
A long road begins with a single step.
After the rain, the ground grows firm.
Failure is the root of success.
Patience pays off in the end.
案ずるより産むが易し
塵も積もれば山となる
Even dust piled up becomes a mountain.
Fortune comes to a smiling home.
